name: Synthetic CI credential event: Observe/Recommend

work.goal: Identify the next observation needed to distinguish an expected CI job from possible credential misuse.
success_criteria: Retain both supplied explanations and the missing discriminating observation.
Return a recommendation with its uncertainty and human use responsibility.
non_goals: No incident determination, credential change, containment or production action.

scope.environment: Synthetic repository and CI event; no live assets are selected.
conditions: The event and explanations are authored fixture data.
No source freshness, access, identity or applicability has been checked.

roles.responsibility: Request and describe relevant event and job metadata.
counterpart_assumptions: A later authorized source owner can provide the selected job manifest.

roles.responsibility: Check whether returned metadata supports either explanation.
counterpart_assumptions: Independent checking requires a distinct actual principal, not another role label.

roles.responsibility: Use the checked recommendation and decide whether any separately authorized next work is appropriate.

inputs.purpose: Describe the unusual event without declaring an incident.
inputs.content: A fixture CI credential was used by an unfamiliar job label outside the usual fixture schedule.
inputs.limitations: Synthetic supplied statement; authenticity, actual source availability and event meaning are unverified.

inputs.purpose: Determine whether an authorized automation change explains the job identity and timing.
inputs.limitations: No manifest, source access or permission is available to this preview.

explanations.description: An authorized automation change may explain the unfamiliar job and schedule.
uncertainties: The current authorized job manifest has not been supplied.

explanations.description: Unauthorized credential use may explain the same event.
uncertainties: The event alone cannot distinguish misuse from an authorized change.

steps.purpose: Ask the source owner for the relevant authorized job manifest and change record.
steps.returns: Selected source-labelled job metadata or an explicit unavailable result.

steps.purpose: Compare the supplied explanations against the checked result and preserve remaining unknowns.
steps.returns: A recommendation, original basis, counterevidence and unresolved next observation.

arrangements.description: Use the source owner's existing selected metadata and current review process.
assumptions: These roles and permissions still require actual bindings.

arrangements.description: Keep the unknown explicit and defer this profile when the required source is unavailable.
assumptions: Deferral is not a declaration that the event is harmless.

separation.reason: The proposed independent check requires distinct actual principals.

requested_permissions.description: Read only the selected fixture job manifest through a later authorized source owner.

reconsider_when: The missing manifest arrives or conflicts with the event.
A source correction or changed permission affects the proposed observation.

revision_basis.reason: First synthetic demonstration; no live observation or prior operational success.
